=== Recent NF-family constructions ===

The latest machines in the R. Gutin and E. Glazer reduction series have the following state counts. See [[New Foundations consistency machines]] for the target theories, construction and verification scope.

{| class="wikitable"
! Target theory !! Working states !! Date !! Source and verification
|-
| NF || '''173''' || 25 November 2026 || [https://github.com/wlad-svennik/notes/tree/main/nf-bb173 Literal table and portable certificates]

The counts include the complete binary machines and blank-tape initialization, excluding the terminal halt state. The releases preserve the earlier refutation-search sources and distinguish the implementation certificates from their inherited written and formal logical calibrations. These construction records do not by themselves establish new exact-table PA or Zermelo transfer theorems.
